title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the 35th anniversary of the fall and destruction of Vukovar
part_text: 3.Acknowledges the important work carried out by the International Criminal Tribunal for the former Yugoslavia in establishing the facts and in investigating and prosecuting serious violations of international humanitarian law, including crimes committed in Vukovar; regrets, however, that not all those bearing responsibility for crimes committed during and after the siege and destruction of the city were brought to justice; calls for continued efforts to bring all remaining perpetrators to justice and for enhanced judicial cooperation, in this regard; stresses that sincere acknowledgement of crimes, respect for victims and the establishment of the fate of those still missing are indispensable foundations for lasting reconciliation, and that justice is owed to all victims of the wars that accompanied the break-up of Yugoslavia; underlines the importance of ensuring that all communities, including representatives of the Serbian minority in Croatia, can commemorate their victims freely and without intimidation, while fully acknowledging the historical responsibility for the atrocities committed in Vukovar;
